go_tracks.track_a: XENO_EXECUTABLE_CONVERGENCE: executable typed ingress admission plus causal route identity primitives added under the current-facing Xeno root
go_tracks.track_b: XCU_AND_ENTRY_FABRIC_CO_DEVELOPMENT: immutable ingress binding, positive engine admission, and H(ingress,engine,router-policy,routing-result) identity

observed_problem.finding: The HCU draft router derives route identity from routing output plus generation, so materially distinct causal events selecting the same lanes can alias. It also treats provider independence through a finite forbidden-provider denylist rather than positive bound engine admission.

hypothesis: One typed ingress identity plus positive canonical engine resolution and a single route identity H(ingress, resolved engine, router policy, routing result) removes event/engine aliasing before XPU/XCU cognition while remaining reusable across GRID10, COGSIM10, WM_TEST, NESTED_SIM and SCALEOUT.
counterhypothesis: Typed ingress and explicit engine/route identity add latency and schema rigidity without materially improving causal auditability because downstream receipts could hash raw inputs ad hoc.

candidate.ingress_identity_formula: sha256(canonical normalized ingress packet fields including payload_sha256)
candidate.route_identity_formula: sha256(canonical ingress_sha256 + causal_id + generation + positively resolved canonical engine identity/class/artifact + engine admission policy digest + router policy digest + routing result digest)
candidate.authority_boundary: admission/binding only; no semantic truth promotion and no effect authority
